videos.description: Large language models (LLMs) have grabbed the attention of AI-minded organizations thanks to their ease of use and broad applications. While commercial offerings like OpenAI’s GPT4 enable teams to rapidly prototype with LLMs, most organizations want to build custom models tuned on proprietary data.
